What we have here is a first generation downhill full suspension mountain bike. She is a 1997 Iron Horse THS-1. This was considered a super bike at the time and the frame alone retailed at over $4000. Only 100 of them were ever made by hand at Foes Fabrication in Pasadena California.

They were made exclusively for the riders of team Iron Horse. I found her all beat to shit at a second hand sports store and completely restored her with all original parts (except the front fork). I found a place that sold brand new old stock parts. Even the tires are original equipment. I am the proud owner of one of the rarest mountain bikes on the planet and a really cool piece of mountain biking history.
